summary: Iteration 51 — Platform Support Bot + Escalation. 20/20 targeted backend tests passing (auth, chat GPT-5.2 real calls, platform-only boundary enforcement, escalate ticket persistence, RBAC on list/patch, resolve/reopen with resolved_at, admin_notes). Frontend E2E: SupportWidget floats on every authenticated page (hidden on landing), chat streams real GPT-5.2 nav guidance, Escalate correctly disabled pre-message and enabled after, ticket confirmation renders in chat, Admin /admin/support-tickets page lists tickets, expands transcript, auto-saves notes on blur, and resolve/reopen cycle works. Regression suites (ask_tutor_perf 15, submission_enrichment 9, magic_link 13, milestone_submit_auto_review 5) all pass. Only unrelated failures were 6 pre-existing test_video_submission_review cases (ffmpeg binary missing + event-loop setup) — not related to this feature.

issues: Route is guarded only by ProtectedRoute (authenticated). Instructors/students can navigate to the URL directly; the page shell renders and API returns 403 (toast 'Super admin access required') with an empty list. Server-side security is fine, but consider adding a client-side role guard (redirect non-super_admin to /dashboard) to avoid rendering the empty page + toast.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add super_admin role check inside AdminSupportTicketsPage (or a wrapper route) to redirect non-super_admin users to /dashboard instead of rendering the shell + 'Super admin access required' toast.
PRE-EXISTING (not this feature): test_video_submission_review.py has 6 failing tests due to missing ffmpeg binary + event-loop init — unrelated to the support feature.
critical_code_review_comments: SupportWidget history cap: client sends slice(-8) while backend caps at prior[-6:] — mismatch is harmless (backend truncates further) but consider aligning to 6 to avoid wasted payload.
support_chat exception handler swallows the LLM exception and returns 500 without exposing detail (correct). No sensitive data leaks.
support_escalate is best-effort with email — good pattern. Uses SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL env with a users.find_one fallback.

AdminSupportTicketsPage uses `defaultValue` + `onBlur` for admin_notes autosave — works, but if the ticket list re-renders (e.g. after Resolve), the textarea keeps its React state instead of the updated t.admin_notes. Since resolve triggers a state replace of that ticket, React may unmount/remount and this is fine — but worth eyeballing if any UX regressions surface.
test_credentials: Seeded temporary student + super_admin session tokens directly into user_sessions collection; cleaned up after tests. Real production super_admin (slewis@theboostpad.org) not used.
seed_data_creation: Test fixture in /app/backend/tests/test_support.py seeds student, instructor, super_admin users + session tokens with TEST_SUPPORT_ prefix; teardown removes all TEST_SUPPORT_ users/sessions and their tickets. Frontend E2E seeded TEST_UI_ prefixed docs, also cleaned up post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 4 new endpoints (/api/support/chat, /api/support/escalate, GET /api/admin/support/tickets, PATCH /api/admin/support/tickets/{id}) are covered by /app/backend/tests/test_support.py (20 tests including 3 real GPT-5.2 calls). Widget and admin page pass full E2E. Only enhancement suggested is a client-side role guard on /admin/support-tickets (currently only ProtectedRoute — API enforces super_admin correctly).
rca of the issue: No bug found — feature works as specified.
